summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by OceanaGold Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the voting results from its 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders. The filing discloses that 82.06% of shares were represented; all director nominees were elected (with one nominee receiving 77.70% support), the auditor was appointed, and advisory resolutions on executive compensation and virtual-only meetings were approved. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change—is present. The filing is a routine meeting results report.
